original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Actual choice-to-primary control-edge gap is 12 +/-0.75 native units in one frame.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: control basis, accessibility_box, independently typed near tolerance in pt/dp; both actual controls must be fully visible in same coherent native frame. Source padding cannot substitute.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Status text starts at least 16 native units inside actual painted band.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Separate real statusText and band semantic allocations, gte 16 without tolerance. Source provenance does not certify the measured distance; both public plans use LTR inset_left.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Whole leading 4 percent of status is empty of text/other paint and contains only status fill.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Full physical-left strip [0,0,.04,1], support 1.0, zero RGB tolerance and opaque exact state fill in original fully visible frame. RTL private variant is not present in this scoped public design.

original_clause_mappings.clause: All text visibly wraps completely.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Eight separately sourced propositions; six compact text-role target rules in every state, expanded heading/body rules on permitted and requested full sweeps. No computed font is fabricated.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Text uses no line limits.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Current rendered propositions can detect clipping on fixed samples but do not establish uncapped line configuration. No source-audit proposition covers absence of line limits. R2 requires this source constraint in addition to retained runtime wrapping.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Status grows to accommodate wrapped status text.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: P2 ready/requested/held status wraps; complete text and non-overlap are rendered judgments. Nominal minimum 56 is originally advisory, so no unavailable layout-height fact is required.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Do not manufacture scrolling with fixed-height blank spacer rows.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Parent owns scrolling; component has no nested scroller.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Fixed opaque sRGB canvas/surface/ink/status/primary roles have separate rendered evidence.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: All exact expected ARGB values and approved solid regions are independent. Pixel support establishes only sampled painted regions; text ink remains advisory and distinct.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Title hierarchy, wrapping, overlap and clipping have separate source-backed visual propositions.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Native semantic labels, selected and enabled facts establish state.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.rationale: Frozen acceptance requires both original bound judge submissions. This review is feasibility only and does not supply native judge actuals.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Static reference rasterization is not a cross-platform native pixel baseline.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: All 18 SVG/PNG pairs have matching dimensions and source copy. Reference images illustrate structure; target-local native samples use typed values, never static image pixel comparison.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Long expanded content requires overlapping sweeps and actual bottom reachability.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Amended representative permitted/requested full sweeps retain original expanded-state duty. Extra opened/cleared/restored targets are explicitly incomplete for content acceptance.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Disabled attempts do not count as callback dispatch.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Choice/primary callbacks require successful native activation; update requires actual same-process update method and original interval.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.rationale: Feasible representative runtime route and/or separate source proposition; no actual product pass is claimed.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Design and feasibility review precede implementation and SDK use.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: This reviewer accessed no product implementation, SDK/native capture, previous review conclusion or other task. Definitions-only source audit is planning only.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Exact production file locations, module/package and pinned host versions.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Exact file scopes are indexed for both platforms and bridge calls are direct. No pinned repository source was inspected under this review scope.

original_clause_mappings.clause: iOS 14 compatibility.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: The broad production-component proposition does not state deployment/API compatibility. No explicit independently indexed iOS 14 review or pinned minimum-version build route is provided. Frozen observer host targets 17.0; a host run alone would not establish this clause. R1.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Swift TransferHandlingNote public struct, Equatable/Identifiable, public immutable String fields and public initializer.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Bridge compilation will exercise public initialization, but not public property access or Equatable/Identifiable conformance. None of the 84 source propositions specifies complete model API shape. R1.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Swift ColdStorageTransfer public struct, Equatable/Identifiable, declared public immutable typed stored values and public initializer.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Direct public initializer signature is exercised by bridge; exported field access and conformance remain outside explicit propositions. R1.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Swift panel exported View and exact callback initializer plus public body.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Direct external component construction and AnyView conversion exercise public initializer and View conformance; full public surface still belongs in the API audit gap R1.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Kotlin declared data classes, immutable typed values and model shapes.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Bridge exercises constructor labels/types but does not establish data-class/value-property contract. R1 requires exact declaration audit.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Kotlin @Composable component exact callbacks and Modifier = Modifier argument.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Direct bridge call exercises composability and callbacks but omits modifier, so absence or incorrect type/default of that argument could escape. No exact-API source proposition. R1.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Real production callbacks; bridge only decodes input and forwards callbacks with no UI/state/layout/expected-result/replacement logic.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Both approved bridge bodies were directly inspected, contain only model construction/component call/callback forwarding, and match locked launch byte SHAs. No wrapper identity or layout is present.

original_clause_mappings.clause: Stable String IDs and unique note IDs within each model.
original_clause_mappings.rationale: Fixed caller IDs and note uniqueness are valid. Model API declaration enforcement is covered by R1 rather than claimed from runtime.
